title: aspidium effusum
intro: Aspidium effusum, commonly known as the Lady's fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. The Lady's fern is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of the Lady's fern include its ability to calm the nervous system, relieve anxiety, and aid in wound healing due to its antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of the Lady's fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
